text: The design part of tasks/023 landed (356c09a; plan.md 8, B9): data_sources [{host, access: read_only_anonymous}] beside package_sources in lab_profile.schema.json (policy.execution_permission value) and execution_permission.schema.json; fetches_from on tool_contract.schema.json; B9 judges an install and a fetch each against its own list, neither opening the other, hosts matched by equality.
